capabilities: Create folder trees from indented outlines
Create Markdown notes from name lists
Fill new notes from custom text or a template file
Replace placeholders for names, paths and dates
disambiguation: Not a folder-organizing or file-explorer tool; it only creates folders and notes from pasted text.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README and UI; overwriting an existing note cannot be undone; runs a read-only preflight before writing; works on desktop and mobile without Node fs.
intentEvidence: this version is a rewrite and extension of that idea
problem: Building many folders and notes by hand in Obsidian is slow and repetitive.

relations.evidence: The first version was based on the "auto generate folders" plugin by the Bilibili creator 拈花赛博行
Add Gowntn/obsidian-folder-forge in BRAT, then enable the plugin.

summary: Creates folder trees and Markdown notes in bulk from an indented outline or a name list, with optional folder index notes.
